video.agency.evidence: [秀逗魔导士·codex] 第1张图中，0.0–1.5秒她面向远处逼近的敌人保持备战姿态；约1.75–2.25秒开始前倾并向前出手，敌人尚未到她跟前；7.5–10.0秒敌人倒地后，她逐渐收势站直。；[食尸鬼·claude] Sheet 1, 2.0–2.5 s (row 2, cells 1–3): the lead ghoul is upright and walking. It is not charging on all fours at full speed, and it already looks fairly large, so it may be closer than the required 10 m. In the same three cells, the other three ghouls in the background stay at about the same place on the road. They look like they are standing in line waiting, not charging one after another. Row 1 (0.75–1.75 s) also shows little change in the far group's position between cells. At 2.5–3.25 s the lead ghoul crouches and the fire swallows it. I cannot see whether it tries to jump to the roadside, as the 2.4–3.6 s beat requires. From 3.75 to 5.75 s (rows 2–3), the burning ghouls stay crouched in one cluster with little visible movement. I cannot confirm that two of them crawl one or two steps toward her. From 6.0 to 7.5 s (row 4) there is rolling and falling, which reacts to the fire as it should. Because of the waiting in the opening charge and the dodge and crawl I cannot confirm, I am judging this a fail.

From 3.75 to 5.75 s (row 3), the spec says two burning ghouls look up and stare at her. In the sheet they are only small burning, smoking shapes, so I cannot see their heads or eyes. video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Seen as a first-time viewer, the strip tells one clear story. Row 1, 0.00–1.75s: a red-haired woman in red stands in the foreground with both hands glowing with fire, while a group of beast-like monsters comes down the dirt road behind her. Row 2, 2.00–2.50s: she turns toward the monsters and throws a fireball. At 2.75s it turns into a fire phoenix, which spreads its wings at 3.00–3.25s and sweeps along the road toward the monsters at 3.50–3.75s. Row 3, 4.00–5.75s: the phoenix flame crashes into the monsters, and they are hit, burning and smoking. Row 4, 6.00–7.75s: the monsters are on fire and falling to the ground. Rows 5–6, 8.00–11.75s: as the smoke clears, the monsters lie motionless on the road while she lowers her hand and stands upright. Who acts, what skill (fireball turning into a phoenix), who is hit (the monster group) and the result (all of them knocked down) are all clear. One small weakness: the monsters are far away and small in frame, so their exact species is hard to make out, but this doesn't stop a viewer from understanding the cast-hit-result chain.
